sections.title: Intelligent Enterprise Platforms
sections.subtitle: Run the core of the enterprise on connected ERP and CRM platforms, made smarter with AI.

sections.heading: ERP and CRM implementation for *connected operations*
sections.body:
Choose, implement, connect and support the platforms that run finance, operations and customer engagement. Plan the lifecycle from platform selection and migration to application management services (AMS) and optimisation.

Customer 360 journeys and self-service or partner portals extend the core platform. AI-assisted workflow orchestration can be considered where process, data and control requirements fit. [Discuss your ERP or CRM priorities](#get-in-touch).

sections.description: Choose the specialist service that fits your next decision.

items.title: Zoho

items.title: Salesforce

sections.heading: Make platform change *business-ready*
sections.description: Enterprise Platforms contributes platform selection, process integration, data reconciliation and the handover to managed operations.

plays.title: Modernisation & Programme Assurance
plays.trigger: ERP/CRM migration and customisation introduce data and regression risk.
plays.outcome: Start with migration readiness and a reconciliation plan. Combine integration checks and regression evidence for business acceptance.

plays.title: Intelligent Operations
plays.trigger: Disconnected finance, operations and customer processes create manual work.
plays.outcome: Start with an ERP/CRM process and interface map. Prioritise integrated workflows and agree process-level measures before automation.
plays.ip: Linkworks, Intelligent Workflow Automation Framework, testoriumz, Cyber-Safe Delivery

sections.heading: A composable platform *where ERP and CRM do not fit*
sections.description: Use Linkfields software on its own or alongside specialist services.

items.title: Linkworks
items.description: Extend the core with customised ERP, CRM and complex business applications. Microservices, REST APIs and composable UI support workflows and portals that a standard platform does not cover.

items.title: Migration and operations accelerators
items.description: Migration & Readiness, Regression & Release Assurance, Data Migration & Reconciliation and Intelligent Platform Operations provide reusable delivery IP for platform change.

sections.noteLabel: Software and services are separate choices
sections.note: Products are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without services. Agree deployment, data handling and integrations. Oracle [migration and AMS](/services/intelligent-enterprise-platforms/platform-migration-ams) scope, platform versions and support responsibilities are established during scoping.

sections.heading: From platform choice to managed operations
sections.description: Illustrative engagement pattern: agree scope, owners and acceptance criteria before delivery.

items.title: Assess and select
items.description: Map business processes, platform fit, data quality and integration needs. Agree the migration and support boundaries.

items.title: Implement and migrate
items.description: Configure or extend the platform, migrate and reconcile data, and run business-process regression checks.

items.title: Operate and optimise
items.description: Transition to AMS when service ownership, knowledge transfer and support scope are agreed. Set service levels in the engagement.

sections.note: Agree mapping, reconciliation, regression and business-sign-off evidence, plus known issues, escalation and integration ownership for AMS. Service levels and software licences are scoped separately.
